content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-33. - System substituted for state-legislated police retirement system.
content.summary:

faqs.q: Sec. 86-33. - System substituted for state-legislated police retirement system.
faqs.a:
The city is hereby exempted from all provisions of C.R.S. § 31-30-601 et seq., and
               the city police retirement system as set forth in this chapter is hereby continued
               and declared to be the alternative police pension benefit program for the city.
(Code 1981, § 26-3; Ord. No. 1508, § 2, 11-20-1978)
State Law reference—
Authority of municipal police pension fund to be excluded from state-legislated police
               pension fund, C.R.S. § 31-30-621.
